description: Reproduced during GH239 real-cluster snapshot fault fixture: Process.exit(materializer, :kill) triggers automatic restart; immediate Foreman.remove_worker(id) removes worker map entry, then the restarted worker sends worker_health {:ok,pid}. Foreman.Impl.do_worker_health/3 calls State.put_health_for_worker/3 -> Map.update! on missing id and crashes Foreman with KeyError. Evidence /tmp/bedrock-239-snapshot-foreman-race.log, stack impl.ex:351/state.ex:56/server.ex:80. Related gu0.2 concerns missed slow restart state, jq8 concerns start-task exit; neither covers a late health cast after legitimate removal. Investigate incarnation-aware or absent-worker handling; add deterministic regression for removal before queued restart health plus stale old-incarnation health. GH239 fixture waits for actual restart health before eviction to isolate snapshot boundary; no production fix in239.
